# MCEF source availability (LGPL-2.1)

The repository contains `libs/mcef-neoforge-2.1.6-1.21.1.jar` as a build/runtime dependency.
MCEF is licensed under **LGPL-2.1**; the full license text is at
`third_party/licenses/MCEF-LGPL-2.1.txt`.

Corresponding source:

- Upstream: https://github.com/mc-wiki/mcef
- Version: 2.1.6 / NeoForge 1.21.1
- Source archive/releases: https://github.com/mc-wiki/mcef/releases

If the exact 2.1.6 source is no longer available at the upstream link, open an issue in this
repository and the maintainer will provide the corresponding source for the distributed binary.

MCEF is not unpacked into `financialmarket-*.jar`; players install the MCEF mod separately.
